title: Plant Manager PA
text:
**Why you will love working at Maola Local Dairies™**:

* Built on over a century of dedication, Maola is always looking ahead investing in our people, strengthening our communities, and securing fresh, local dairy for the future.
* Join a farmer-owned cooperative rooted in integrity, sustainability, and a passion for providing fresh, high-quality Maola dairy products.
* We prioritize your well-being with competitive pay, including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off, and more
* Our employees are an integral part of who we are — what you do and what you think matters.

**SUMMARY:**

The Plant Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for all manufacturing at Maola Local Dairies – Philadelphia. 
 
You will execute strategies to optimize safety, food quality, performance, equipment reliability, cost-effectiveness, and profitability. You will build a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement while developing a high-performing leadership team to drive sustainable results. This role requires a hands-on, results-oriented leader with extensive manufacturing experience, technical expertise in fluid milk processing and packaging, strong financial acumen, and proven success in a unionized facility. You must translate company goals into clear departmental priorities and ensure consistent execution across the entire plant.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**1. Operational Leadership & Manufacturing Performance**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for daily plant operations, ensuring production schedules, customer requirements, and business objectives are consistently achieved.
* Establish and maintain operational standards that drive improvements in production efficiency, OEE, throughput, yield, and order fulfillment.
* Demonstrate strong technical understanding of pasteurization, UHT processing, fluid milk manufacturing, and packaging operations.
* Drive equipment reliability and asset utilization through effective partnership with Maintenance and Engineering leadership.
* Establish disciplined management routines, performance reviews, and accountability systems to identify and eliminate operational losses.
* Ensure effective coordination between Production, Maintenance, Quality, Sanitation, Warehousing, and Scheduling.

**2. Financial & Business Management**

* Maintain full operational and financial accountability for plant performance, including operating budgets, labor costs, maintenance expenditures, material utilization, and manufacturing costs.
* Partner with department leaders to establish, manage, and maintain departmental budgets.
* Monitor plant financial performance against established budgets and proactively address unfavorable variances.
* Develop and execute cost-reduction strategies focused on eliminating waste, reducing overtime, improving labor productivity, and optimizing maintenance expenditures.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of plant P&L performance, cost per unit, conversion costs, and key manufacturing financial indicators.
* Ensure department heads understand their financial responsibilities and maintain ownership of their respective budgets.

**3. TPM & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the implementation and sustainment of TPM principles and continuous improvement methodologies throughout the facility.
* Establish a culture focused on identifying, understanding, and eliminating the root causes of operational losses.
* Drive improvements in equipment reliability, preventive maintenance execution, planned maintenance, and overall asset effectiveness.
* Challenge normalized deviance and reinforce adherence to established operating standards and best practices.
* Develop structured problem-solving capabilities throughout the leadership team and frontline organization.
* Establish meaningful performance indicators and management routines to measure progress, sustain improvements, and reinforce accountability.

**4. Safety, Food Safety & Quality**

* Establish and maintain an uncompromising commitment to employee safety, food safety, and product quality.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, company policies, food safety programs, and manufacturing standards.
* Partner with Quality and Sanitation leadership to prevent quality failures, reduce product holds, minimize waste, and protect customer confidence.
* Ensure incidents, deviations, and nonconformances receive appropriate investigation, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Promote proactive employee engagement and leadership participation in safety and quality initiatives.

**5. Leadership, Organizational Development & Labor Relations**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a capable and accountable management team.
* Establish clear performance expectations and ensure department leaders demonstrate ownership of their respective areas.
* Build organizational capability through leadership development, employee engagement, succession planning, and effective performance management.
* Demonstrate authentic, approachable, and visible leadership throughout all levels of the facility.
* Foster a positive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented environment that encourages initiative, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrate the ability to effectively lead and develop a unionized workforce through constructive labor relations, consistent application of collective bargaining agreements, and proactive employee engagement.
* Establish productive working relationships with union representatives and employees while balancing organizational objectives, workforce needs, and contractual obligations.
* Address employee relations matters with professionalism, consistency, fairness, and sound judgment.
* Promote a culture of mutual respect, accountability, and shared responsibility for operational performance.

**6. Customer & Executive Engagement**

* Effectively communicate plant performance, business challenges, operational priorities, and improvement initiatives to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Represent the Philadelphia facility professionally in customer interactions, audits, and business reviews as needed.
* Ensure customer commitments, product quality expectations, and service requirements remain central to operational decision-making.
* Establish cross-functional partnerships that support broader organizational objectives and business growth.

**BASIC REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, preferably within the dairy, fluid milk, food, or beverage manufacturing industries required
* Minimum of 7 years of experience successfully leading a unionized manufacturing workforce, including labor relations, employee engagement, and collective bargaining agreement administration required.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience leading complex manufacturing operations with multiple production lines and supporting departments required.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with technical knowledge of pasteurization, fluid milk processing, and packaging equipment and systems required.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience managing operating budgets, departmental expenditures, and plant P&L performance required.
* Minimum of 5 year of experience in improving manufacturing efficiency, equipment reliability, labor productivity, and cost performance required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience implementing TPM, Lean Manufacturing, or other continuous improvement methodologies required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience leading, developing, and holding department-level leadership teams accountable for measurable results required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience understanding of food safety, quality systems, regulatory compliance, and workplace safety required.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Communication
* + *Communicate clearly and effectively through multiple channels – oral, written, visual, and non-verbal – ensuring our messages are understood and delivered appropriately, whether in-person or digitally.*
* Accountability
* + *Take responsibility for actions and anticipate challenges before they arise.*
 + *Solve problems both within and outside of departments, proactively addressing issues as they occur.*
* Customer Focused
* + *Prioritize understanding and meeting both internal and external customer needs.*
 + *Ensure high levels of satisfaction and loyalty by anticipating customer requirements and striving for exceptional service.*
* Initiative
* + *Proactive in identifying opportunities and addressing potential threats.*
 + *Act independently and decisively, rather than waiting for situations to demand action.*
* Problem-Solving
* + *Possess the ability to identify and address complex issues with minimal guidance.*
 + *Skilled at analyzing challenges and finding practical, effective solutions.*
* Collaboration
* + *Take responsibility for deliverables while also supporting others to ensure that collective goals are met.*
 + *Able to work harmoniously with others toward a common goal, recognizing and valuing each person’s contributions, is fundamental to successful collaboration.*

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand and walk. The employee must be able to reach, bend, extend, and lift 50-60 pounds.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* The work environment may require working in the cooler room with varying degrees of temperature and may include contact with water or dairy liquids.
* Exposed to a noise level of 90 decibels. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate/high. Wet/slippery work conditions.

**Maola Local Dairies®** is a farmer-owned cooperative sustainably producing a full suite of nutritious dairy products. Maola processes milk, cream, butter, and dry milk powders through our network of six dairy processing plants. With a keen eye on quality, freshness, and love for the environment, Maola delivers dairy products that are both nutritious and sustainable to our local communities. For more information about Maola, please visit **www.maolamilk.com** (http://www.maolamilk.com/)**.**
